Seated with both hands on the steering wheel, he looks startled, lets go, climbs out of the red toy car, and runs away with his back to the camera as it follows him. The change happens all at once while he runs with his back to the camera: his age, hair, clothes and the place all turn into the second photo's together. The same movement carries on through the change without a break: Still running across the indoor tiles, he turns, lies back, and looks up. Then he eases into the second photo's pose over the last half second, so the last frame is the second photo. It must look like one continuous movement, never like a cut or a slide change. His face stays one clear face whenever it is visible, never doubled or see-through. In each photo he looks exactly as in that photo (face, eyes, hair). No people, objects or text that are not in the photos. No extra people at any time. No duplicate car at any time. By the end there is no red toy car, no steering wheel, no gray sweatshirt.
